records.text: A source at Utah Valley University said a suspicious man seen apparently scouting campus on September 9 told campus security he was Senator Mike Lee's bodyguard checking the site for Lee's safety.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1CFDtD0IgEg)

appearances.snippet: And so they said, we're going to go up to this individual. And when that suspicious individual was approached, he told the campus security that he was Senator Mike Lee's bodyguard, scoping out the area to ensure that the senator was going to be safe ahead of the event. So they said, OK, that makes sense. We'll get we'll let you go.

verification.notes: The transcript establishes that Owens relayed this account from an anonymous UVU source. Current searches of UVU, Utah public-safety, law-enforcement, court, and news materials did not locate an incident report, security log, video, named witness, or official confirmation of the September 9 encounter or the purported bodyguard's statement. Because the claim rests on an anonymous source and no independent evidence was available, it is attempted/unverifiable rather than false.
